title: Debugging the Articleizer: LLM APIs, Regex, and Rate Limits
description: Details the development and debugging of an `articleizer.py` script that automates technical journal publishing. It integrates Gemini LLM APIs for content structuring, YAML front matter, and subheadings, also addressing API nuances like versioning and rate limiting.
context_pointer: The `articleizer.py` script uses the Gemini API to process technical journal entries, generating Jekyll-compatible Markdown files. Key functionalities include content analysis, YAML front matter creation, and automated subheading insertion using regular expressions. The script also features API key management and a local cache for generated instructions, with ongoing debugging efforts focused on improving the reliability of text snippet matching for subheading placement.
